decisions.title: Choose the canonical champion obligation
decisions.recommendation_reason: The configured formula allocates 60% of the $1,200 podium pool and the workbook's full $2,000 payout check passes only with a $720 champion award.

options.label: $720 obligation; $660 paid; $60 outstanding
options.treatment: Generate the $720 rule-backed obligation, import the $660 payment, and preserve the $760 ledger row only as superseded source evidence.

options.label: $760 obligation; $660 paid; $100 outstanding
options.treatment: Use the ledger obligation as canonical and record a documented exception to the configured payout rule.

options.label: $720 obligation; $660 paid; $60 forgiven
options.treatment: Keep the configured obligation and actual payment, then append an audited balance-increasing adjustment that forgives the remaining $60.

decisions.title: Correct the East Side Top Dog dues date
decisions.recommendation_reason: The malformed value resolves to the same month and day in 2925, while serial 45885 is 2025-08-16 and appears on nearby opening-payment rows.

options.label: Correct to 2025-08-16
options.treatment: Import the payment date as 2025-08-16 and retain serial 374603 in raw evidence.

options.label: Treat the exact date as unknown
options.treatment: Do not invent a date; require a separate commissioner-provided date before commit.

decisions.title: Replace broken last-method workbook outputs
decisions.recommendation_reason: Last method is a presentation value, not a financial event. It can be deterministically derived from corrected normalized payments and should not be imported as source truth.

options.label: Derive from normalized payments
options.treatment: Ignore the broken formula outputs and order payments by paid date, source row, and creation timestamp.

options.label: Manually approve each team value
options.treatment: Create ten commissioner decisions for the displayed fallback values.

decisions.title: Choose the authoritative weekly-award source
decisions.recommendation_reason: Weeks 1-14 derive cleanly from the 160 result rows and match the ledger's sequence of 14 high-score obligations and 14 low-score assessments.

options.label: Derive weeks 1-14 from weekly results
options.treatment: Use scores as source facts, generate awards from season rules, and keep helper cells as non-authoritative evidence.

options.label: Import helper outputs directly
options.treatment: Treat cached helper values as source records and document the incomplete formula/layout ranges.

decisions.title: Approve team aliases found outside the Teams sheet
decisions.recommendation_reason: Each variant is unambiguous in its row context and maps to exactly one team in the Teams sheet.

options.label: Approve all four aliases
options.treatment: Create explicit historical team mappings; do not rewrite the raw bet text.

options.label: Review aliases individually
options.treatment: Leave the affected side-bet rows blocked until each alias is confirmed.

decisions.title: Correct the second Napa Kojak penalty date
decisions.recommendation_reason: The 14 assessment rows match the 14 weekly low-score teams in order. Row 58 is the valid week-12 assessment with a copied week-9 date, not a duplicate obligation.

options.label: Keep both; date row 58 as 2025-11-24
options.treatment: Generate separate week-9 and week-12 obligations and preserve the repeated raw date in staging evidence.

options.label: Discard row 58 as a duplicate
options.treatment: Import only 13 penalty assessments and document why the week-12 low-score rule did not generate an obligation.

decisions.title: Approve financial event mappings
decisions.recommendation_reason: Separating source Type and How values preserves obligations and payments as different events while allowing weekly, season-high, and placement categories to retain stable provenance.

options.label: Approve the proposed Type + How mapping
options.treatment: Map Dues, Draft Party, and Penalty Paid to payments from teams; Payout Paid to payments to teams; Penalty Assessed to team obligations; and Payout Obligation subtypes to league obligations with weekly, season-high, and placement categories.

options.label: Provide a custom mapping
options.treatment: Keep the batch blocked until the commissioner specifies different semantics for one or more Type + How combinations.

recommended_batch_action.description: Approve the recommended treatments for six operational findings, then choose the champion payout treatment separately.
